title: Chapter 130 Because Of You
content:
Chapter 130 Because Of You

Dongdongdongdongdongdong!

A knock on the door sounded.

The next moment, with a creak, the door slowly opened.

A woman in a light long dress appeared in her sight.

When the woman saw An Xing, she immediately showed two dimples.

"Xiao An, you are here."

An Xing's face turned slightly red, and then he reached out and stuffed the flower in his hand into the woman's hand.

"When I came here, I saw it by chance. I thought it looked pretty good, so I bought it for you."

Looking at the flowers in his hand, the woman raised her eyebrows slightly.

There are so many tricks, and it is carefully selected at first glance.

He looked up at An Xing, and saw his expression dodging, his ears were red.

It is hard to believe that this is the leader of the most terrorist organization in Huangcheng.

The woman obviously didn't know An Xing's identity in Huangcheng.

Those were not important to her.

Seeing An Xing look like this at this time, the woman couldn't help but cover her mouth and laugh.

And this smile made An Xing feel rippling.

This is his white moonlight!

And now, he feels that his opportunity has come!

Even if he was beaten to death, he would never have thought that this little girl would ascend from the Hongmeng Space.

When he learned the news, he flew up excitedly.

"Hey, hey, what are you thinking?"

At this time, Xiao Yun'er looked at An Xing who was distracted and then waved to An Xing.

Suddenly, An Xing quickly came back to his senses.

"Ah haha, it's okay."

"Yun'er, I haven't seen you for so long. You are not familiar with the place. I'll take you to get to know the city."

Hearing this, Xiao Yuner nodded.

"Okay, then I'll bother you."

Hearing this, An Xing waved his hand quickly, "No trouble, no trouble, I'm still idle anyway."

Immediately, the two walked side by side towards the street.

After Xiao Yun'er ascended, not long after, An Xing rushed back.

Without saying a word, Xiao Yuner arranged a quiet courtyard.

Regarding Xiao Yuner's question, An Xing just said that he had a job in the deserted city.

Xiao Yuner didn't ask much about this.

"Yun'er, do you remember the first time we met?"

As she walked, An Xing suddenly asked.

At this time, Xiao Yun'er was still looking around at the scene in the city with curious eyes.

Xiao Yuner was extremely shocked about everything in the deserted city.

Hearing An Xing's words, Xiao Yun'er was stunned, then nodded and said, "Of course I remember."

When she first met An Xing, she almost scared her to death.

She has never seen such a thin person since she was a child.

At that time, An Xing was so thin that he was only one bone-like frame left.

"You, are you okay?"

In an abandoned mansion, Xiao Yun'er, who was passing by, happened to walk in. He wanted to see if there were any unexpected gains, but he found a skinny boy lying inside.

I thought the other party was dead, but after seeing him, the other party actually opened his eyes.

"Hungry, so hungry."

Hearing this, Xiao Yuner didn't say anything and directly used her spiritual energy to inject it into An Xing's body. In less than a moment, An Xing recovered some of his physical strength and sat up.

"You, are you a cultivator?!"

Feeling Xiao Yuner's methods, An Xing suddenly widened his eyes.

For the legendary practitioner, it is an unattainable existence for him.

But Xiao Yun'er said directly: "You eat something first."

Immediately, Xiao Yun'er took out the food and handed it to An Xing.

Looking at the food in his hand, An Xing was stunned and swallowed it voraciously.

"Thank you, you're such a hiccup~, good guy."

After a long time, An Xing finally got full and immediately thanked him.

He hasn't filled his stomach for a long time.

Now, even if he dies, he will have no regrets.

Looking at An Xing who had recovered his energy, Xiao Yun'er also laughed.

"It's good that you're fine, then I'll leave first."

After saying that, Xiao Yun'er was about to leave.

But at this time, An Xing stopped her.

"Oh, girl,"

"What's wrong?"

"I, I don't know what your name is yet? Don't get me wrong. I just think that if I have the ability in the future, I will definitely repay you."

Hearing this, Xiao Yun'er was stunned and her eyes looked at An Xing suddenly became more dazzling.

"My name is Xiao Yun'er. If you have the chance, you can come to the Xiao family in Yunzhou to find me."

"Miss Xiao, I remember it. My name is An Xing. I will definitely repay you in the future."

He knew that he had nothing now, and he was even a waste who was inferior to ordinary people and could not repay the other party at all.

But he is a person who will repay kindness. Since the other party saved his life, he will definitely repay the other party.

Looking at An Xing with a firm look, Xiao Yun'er was a little stunned.

This was just her doing it casually, and she didn't expect the other party to be so serious.

After a moment of silence, Xiao Yun'er took out a pill and handed it to An Xing.

"This is for you, it will be helpful to you in the future."

"We, please see you again if you are destined to do so."

Immediately, Xiao Yun'er left directly.

An Xing stood there, looking at the pill in his hand, unable to come back to his senses for a long time.

From this moment on, An Xing's heart had a light.

And it is also since then that a generation of geniuses emerged, sweeping away all the geniuses of the same generation and overwhelming an era.

Later, An Xing came to Yunzhou where Xiao Yuner was and found the Xiao family.

He fulfilled his promise and really came to find her.

That period of time was the happiest time in An Xing's life.

Unfortunately, happiness is always short-lived.

Xiao Yun'er fell into danger.

The young master of Yunzong, the strongest force in Yunzhou, coveted Xiao Yun'er's beauty and forced her to marry him.

Xiao Yun'er did not agree to this, and the entire Xiao family was targeted as a result.

In the end, the Xiao family had no choice but to agree, and Xiao Yun'er was placed under house arrest.

When An Xing learned the news, he went to Yunzong alone without any nonsense.

In the end, An Xing forcibly cut off the head of the young master of Yunzong in the hands of several top masters, fled with serious injuries, and was chased to the legendary land of nothingness.

The land of nothingness, a terrifying and desperate place, it is almost impossible for anyone to survive.

What's more, An Xing was seriously injured.

Everyone thought that An Xing died in the land of nothingness, but only Xiao Yun'er still believed that he was still alive.

Since then, Xiao Yuner has never seen An Xing again, nor heard any news about An Xing.

Until not long ago, he ascended here.

"What happened back then,"

Xiao Yuner hesitated.

Hearing this, An Xing smiled and said, "I was a little impulsive about what happened back then. By the way, did your family blame you after that?"

Xiao Yuner shook her head.

Seeing this, An Xing nodded and said, "That's good."

"Since you entered the void, I left the family."

At this time, Xiao Yuner suddenly said.

Hearing this, An Xing was stunned. Looking at Xiao Yuner, An Xing was a little puzzled, "Why?"

At this time, Xiao Yuner's eyes suddenly began to turn red, and she stretched out her index finger and pointed at An Xing's chest, "Because of you."

"Me?"

For some reason, An Xing's heartbeat suddenly accelerated at this moment.

"Do you know why I ascended?"

Hearing this, An Xing was silent.

Xiao Yuner continued, "Because I have been looking for you throughout the entire Hongmeng Universe."
